profile.headline: Software Engineer at Luma Financial Technologies
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: I maintain and work on one of Southwest's core databases which receives, holds, and distributes flight data to internal applications and users as well as customers and airport display systems.

positions.title: End User Support Specialist
positions.description: Provided solutions to users within Fidelity's employee network via a chat tool or phone. From users needing help with access requests to needing help with software or hardware issues. Anything a user felt we could fix, we would try to remediate or direct to a better source and document all the steps we take to track best and easiest fixes for future users.

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description: I worked as a Systems Engineer alongside a colleague to implement a full stack web application for Fidelity Investments' TechWorks Department. I worked on the back-end, writing code in Java using the Spring framework to create an API (application program interface) which connected to a RDBMS (relational database management system) I created using MySQL in order for the TechWorks department to analyze where our phone-line team made errors in documenting they're client calls.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Dallas

volunteerExperiences.description:
I helped pick up trash in and around the Dallas Zoo to help clean the litter many visitors leave behind.
Worked with a group of middle school-aged girls in building KANO kits as well as code in them using shell script.
Worked with 6 Stones to maintain a community garden
I helped organize practice session once a week for a boy's youth soccer team as well as manage the team during official soccer games on weekends
